latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of jy-a-stock-earnings-review – generates professional A-share company earnings review reports.

- Generates A股上市公司财报点评报告 with 6 core sections in券商研报 style, including financial analysis, business segment breakdown, profitability & expense analysis, outlook, risks, and investment advice.
- Fetches all required data via mcporter calls to 聚源数据 MCP services, including financials, industry metrics, sentiment, and valuation data.
- Auto-creates 8 standardized echarts visualizations (revenue, profit, margins, etc.) with data source and date labeling.
- Supports querying by company name or stock code, with automatic/latest or user-specified report period.
- Includes strict environment/setup checks, data validity verification, and clear documentation for installation and usage.
- Provides report in Markdown format with chart rendering; source and update time clearly indicated.
